Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

Literal pools, `adr` and interworking in Thumb code, checked against GNU as;
see arm-gas.txt.

=== literals loaded from a pool at the end of the section
        .syntax unified
        .text
entry:  ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        ldr     r1, =msg
        ldr     r8, =msg + 3
        ldr     r3, =0xff
        movs    r0, r0
        bx      lr
        .data
msg:    .ascii  "hello"

=== a load that needs 32 bits to reach its pool
        .syntax unified
entry:  ldr     r0, =data
        ldr     r1, =data + 4
        .space  1020
        .ltorg
        bx      lr
        .data
        .space  3
data:   .word   0

=== adr within a section @ 0x9002
        .syntax unified
back:   adr     r0, back
        adr     r1, fwd
        adr     r2, far
        .p2align 2, 0
fwd:    nop
        .space  0x800
        .p2align 2, 0
far:    bx      lr

=== a section a linker places at an odd halfword
        .syntax unified
        .text
        nop
        .section .text.b, "ax"
        .thumb_func
fc:     push    {r4, lr}
        pop     {r4, pc}
        adr     r1, fc
        adr     r2, fwd
        blx     fwd
        bx      lr
        .thumb_func
fwd:    bx      lr
